descriptionChirho: The Aramean king of Zobah defeated by David, mentioned extensively in 2 Samuel 8, 10 and 1 Chronicles 18-19. All 21 occurrences refer to the same historical figure regardless of prepositional prefix (of, to, against). Eng 'Hadadezer', spa 'Hadad-ezer / Hadadezer', hin 'Hadadejara', arb 'Hadadazar', kor 'Hadatesel', swa 'Hadadezeri'. The 'against' prefix in S92479 is purely syntactic, not a distinct referent.
